name: Orbit compiled vector unit
target: Qwen-style weighted SwiGLU numerical circuit IR
precision: float64 circuit arithmetic; float32 vector outputs
description: Fixed up/gate/down coefficients implement arithmetic and nonlinear approximations. Host code schedules vector addresses and loops; scalar arithmetic is evaluated by the compiled weight circuits.

multiply.name: multiply
multiply.precision: float32 target; float64 numerical IR executor
multiply.notes: SiLU(K*b)/K approximates ReLU(b). Per-unit absolute output error is at most |coefficient*a|*0.279/K before target rounding. This is not a bf16 exactness guarantee or a merged Hugging Face checkpoint.
